title: Protected query subspace
formal_object: Bilinear score q^T(I+Delta)c; orthonormal training-only basis R of protected queries; P=I-RR^T.
assumptions: R^T R=I and P is fixed from fitting data.
Protection means raw bilinear logits, not renormalized embeddings or whole-task accuracy.
Candidate inputs, pooling and score temperature do not change.

operations.output: Every feasible update is Delta=P Z.

operations.condition: Use the same fixed raw score on both arms
operations.output: Only q_perp contributes and controls drift.

derivation_steps.statement: P^2=P and R^T P=0; R^T Delta=0 iff Delta=P Delta.
derivation_steps.justification: Multiply by RR^T and decompose any matrix into subspace and complement rows.

derivation_steps.statement: For q in span(R), q^T Delta c=0.
derivation_steps.justification: q=R a makes q^T Delta=a^T R^T Delta zero without needing c to be protected.
Cauchy-Schwarz and the induced operator norm on the complement.

derivation_steps.statement: Use x_P=vec((Pq)(c_pos-c_neg)^T)/T, ridge solve for Z and return I+PZ.
derivation_steps.justification: The parametrization enforces the linear constraint; same ridge objective has a unique solution at lambda>0.

method_expression: Fit Delta=PZ with fixed R/P; emit raw bilinear logits without a second normalization.
distinguishing_prediction: At equal update norm, raw score drift is zero on protected span and bounded proportionally to query distance from that span. This does not assert whole-group preservation.
falsifier: Nonzero protected-span score drift refutes the implementation. No better drift/quality tradeoff than an unconstrained ridge/trust-region control defeats necessity.
closest_alternative: PCGrad projects task gradients only on conflict; fixed subspace-constrained least squares imposes exact score invariants. Neither comparison establishes originality.
decisive_comparison: Use native queries and original candidates with fixed R; compare same-teacher unconstrained, norm-matched ridge and PCGrad, accounting for the choice of protected rank using only development data.
legacy_code_audit: Legacy fit(I02) applies P on rows after a dual ridge solve; features returns q@(I+Delta), matching the raw score. No software/numeric receipt for new review.
review_limit: Projection and bound reviewed; protected rank=8 is a historical choice, not evidence of a meaningful protected task.
